entities.name: GlmU Q98LX2
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Mesorhizobium japonicum bifunctional GlmU; 100% identity and coverage.
GlmU catalyzes acetyl transfer from acetyl-CoA to glucosamine-1-phosphate, producing N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphate.
GlmU transfers UMP from UTP to N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphate, producing UDP-N-acetylglucosamine; annotation reports Mg2+ binding.

entities.name: RHEA:13725 GlmU acetyltransferase
observations: Alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + acetyl-CoA = N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + CoA + H+. EC 2.3.1.157.

entities.name: RHEA:13509 GlmU uridylyltransferase
observations: N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine 1-phosphate + UTP + H+ = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine + diphosphate. EC 2.7.7.23.
